 WHEREAS 
 
 The Lessee is a real estate developer, and has undertaken a real estate project named and styled as ‘Mall 35’ comprising inter alia restaurants, hotel apartments, and commercial shops, located at Plot No. 35/A, Police Station Road, Rawalpindi (“ Project ”) ; 
 
 The Lessor is the sole, absolute and exclusive owner of a hotel apartment in ‘Mall 35’ , purchased by the Lessor from the Lessee vide Agreement to Sell No. _______________ dated ________ executed by and between the Parties for sale and leaseback of the hotel apartment ; and 
 
 Pursuant to the terms and conditions of the aforementioned Agreement to Sell , the Lessor desires to lease back to the Lessee, and the Lessee desires to take on lease from the Lessor, the Demised Premises in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Lease back Agreement . 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE , Lessor and Lessee, intending to be legally bound, agree as follows: 
 
 SCOPE AND INTERPRETATION 
 
 Th e Leaseback Agreement (defined below) , along with the Agreement to Sell as well as all annexures attached thereto, and any other document ( s ) forming part of the Leaseback Agreement pursuant to the term and conditions hereof , shall constitute the complete and exclusive agreement between the Parti es hereto in respect of the lease back of the Demised Premises (defined below) . 
 
 The documents specified in Clause 1 above shall be taken as mutually explanatory, and in the event of any conflict, ambiguity or discrepancy, unless otherwise specified, priority shall be given to the General Terms and Conditions attached to the Agreement to Sell , followed by the Agreement to Sell , and D escription of the Purchased Unit attached to the Agreement to Sell . Any terms used as defined terms and not defined in the Leaseback Agreement shall have the meaning assigned to them in the Agreement to Sell . The rules of interpretation set out in the General Terms and Conditions shall apply to all documents forming the Lease back Agreement.

 Unless inconsistent with the context, the following words will have the meanings assigned below: 
 
 Agreement to Sell means the Agreement to Sell executed by and between the Lessor and the Lessee for the sale and leaseback of the Demised Premises, as specified in Recital (B) of th is Leaseback Agreement. 
 
 Common Areas means those parts of the Project not physically forming a part of any U nit including inter alia all open areas, elevators, administrative office areas, security system, lobbies and hallways. 
 
 Common Facilities means all ro ads, pavements, water features , installations, elevators, power backup equipment, security system, tube-well motors, improvements and common assets of the Common Areas do not form part of the Demised Premises.

 Competent Authority means any federal, provincial, capital or local government or authority, department, local, regulatory, statutory or housing authority including the Office of the Cantonment Board Rawalpindi, Office of the Military Estate s Officer Rawalpindi , and any other authority which has jurisdiction over any aspect or part of the Project or th is Lease back Agreement.

 TERM OF LEASE 
 
 The Lessor hereby agrees to irrevocably leaseback , and the Lessee hereby agrees to take on lease from the Lessor, the Demised Premises for an initial duration and lock-in period of ten (10) years which may be renewed in accordance with C lause 31 hereof (the “ Lease Period ”). The Lease Period shall commence on the Commencement Date . 
 
 RENT 
 
 In consideration of the lease of the Demised Premises, the Lessee shall pay Rent and other benefits to the Lessor during the Lease Period on the following terms: 
 
 Monthly Rent shall be paid on a pro-rated basis calculated at 7% of the Purchase Price of the Demised Premises per annum . 
 
 Rent shall be increased by 25% (twenty five percent) every three years of the Lease Period. 
 
 Rent shall be paid for eleven (11) months per year of the Lease Period , along with thirty (30) C omplimentary Vouchers . The Complimentary Vouchers may be redeemed or encashed by the Lessor in accordance with Clause 7 of th is Leaseback Agreement. 
 
 COMPLIMENTARY VOUCHERS 
 
 Complimentary Vouchers may be redeemed or encashed by the Lessor as per the following terms : 
 
 A maximum of fifteen (15) Complimentary Vouchers may be redeemed during peak season, and fifteen (15) during off-peak season , subject to availability and confirmation by the Hotel Management Company . 
 
 Complimentary Vouchers may be redeemed by the Lessor, either her/himself or for friends and family ( the “ Beneficiary ”), subject to availability. The Beneficiary shall have access to all Common F acilities and amenities of fered by the Hotel Management Company during their stay , as per the rules and regulations of the Hotel Management Company, and any additional services may be availed as per the standard schedule of rates &amp; charges specified by the Hotel Management Company. 
 
 The Lessor may , at Lessor’s option, encash all thirty (30) Complimentary Vouchers in exchange for one month’s Rent. For the avoidance of doubt, one month ’s R ent under this Clause 7 (iii) shall only be claimed against thirty ( 30 ) unredeemed and valid Complimentary Vouchers . 
 
 Complimentary Vouchers shall be valid for a period of twelve (12) months from the date of issuance thereof and, if not redeemed or encashed during the validity period, shall not be carried forward for any further period. 
 
 OTHER CHARGES 
 
 All applicable taxes shall be borne and paid by the Parties in accordance with law. 
 
 
 PERMITTED USE 
 
 The Lessee will use , occupy , sub-lease the Demised Premises for the purpose of operating, managing and maintaining a h otel, either itself or through a Hotel Management Company, for the duration of the Lease Period. 
 
 The Lessee will comply with all applicable laws, ordinances, rules, orders, and regulations of any Competent Authority with respect to the Demised Premises and Permitted Use . 
 
 SALE AND ASSIGNMENT 
 
 The Lessor shall only sell / transfer or assign the Demised Premises in accordance with the Agreement to Sell and the Rules, provided that the transferee has agreed and undertaken in writing to be bound by this Agreement and has signed a letter of adherence or such other document as may be prescribed in this regard. . 
 
 The Lessee shall have the right to sublease all or any part of the Demised Premises during the Lease Period at the Lessee’s own discretion , and the Lessor hereby undertakes to do or cause to be done all such acts , deeds and the things and execute any documents required in relation or ancillary thereto. Provided that any such sublease shall be subject to the terms and conditions of this Leaseback Agreement and the Lessee’s obligation for payment of Rent hereunder. 
 
 L ESSOR’S COVENANTS 
 
 The Lessor permits the Lessee to carry out any required internal partitions, modifications, or to dismantle or make alteration(s) to the Demised Premises , and install any billboards, hoardings, signage or any other promotional material as it deems fit for the Permitted Use . The Lessee shall also have the right to place and install on the Demised Premises specific outlets and adequate equipment, including inter alia equipment for central air-conditioning (if any). Lessee shall not be liable to remove, at the time of expiry or termination of th is Lease back Agreement, any fixtures and fittings or to reverse alterations as made by the Lessee during the Lease Period . 
 
 The Lessor hereby represents and warrants that at the time of execution of this Leaseback Agreement , the Demised Premises is free from any lien, charge, encumbrance, etc. of whatsoever nature, and that the Demised Premises shall remain unencumbered throughout the Lease Period . 
 
 The Lessor shall not cause the Demised Premise s to become subject to any lien, charge or encumbrance whatsoever. 
 
 The Lessor hereby undertake s that Lessee shall enjoy quiet and peaceful possession of the Demised Premises from the date of signing of this Leaseback Agreement and during the Lease Period, without any hindrance or disturbance . 
 
 The Lessor shall not hinder in any way the Lessee’s right to manage the Demised Premises as it deems fit, including the determination by the Hotel Management Company of the schedule of rates and charges for the hotel, managing occupancy, day to day operations, human resource and other aspects associated with the Permitted Use. 
 
 LESSEE’S COVENANTS 
 
 The Lessee shall regularly and promptly pay the agreed Rent on a monthly basis, along with thirty (30) Complimentary Vouchers, in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Leaseback Agreement. 
 
 The Lessee shall , at its own cost, repair and maintain the Demised Premises, including all fixtures and fittings therein, and shall ensure that the Demised Premises free of any defects and maintained in a good tenantable con dition, during the Lease Period, subject to the provisions of the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 The Lessee shall regularly and promptly pay all utility bills and other related charges during the Lease Period . 
 
 WARRANTIES 
 The Lessor confirms having read, understood and agrees to comply with the provisions of this Leaseback Agreement and by any further terms and conditions as may be prescribed from time to time by the Lessee. 
 
 The Lessor confirms and warrants that all details provided by the Lessor herein are true and correct in all respects. 
 
 The Lessor confirms and warrants that the Lessor (and where there is more than one Lessor , each such Lessor ) has the requisite capacity and authority to enter into the Leaseback Agreement and to perform the obligations hereunder. 
 
 The Lessor represents that it has good, valid, legal and subsisting title to the Demised Premises and is fully authorized to leaseback the Demised Premises. 
 
 The Lessor undertakes that the Lessor shall not terminate this Leaseback Agreement during the lock-in period specified in Clause 5 above. 
 
 The Lessor warrants not to lease, assign, mortgage, encumber or otherwise hypothecate any interest in the Demised Premises other than in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Leaseback Agreement and the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 The Lessor shall ensure that the Lessee enjoy quiet and peaceful possession of the Demised Premises during the Lease Period without any let or hindrance by the Lessor or any person claiming under or in trust for the Lessor. 
 
 The Lessor hereby covenants that grant of this leaseback is in compliance with the conditions of Agreement to Sell. 
 
 EVENTS OF DEFAULT 
 
 I n the event that the Lessee fails to pay Rent for a period of six (6 ) months consecutively, then the Less ee shall do or cause to be done all acts necessary for the rights of the Lessor in the Demised Premises to be recorded in the relevant land registry. 
 
 In the event of breach of its obligations hereunder by the Lessor , the Lessee shall be at liberty for recourse and r edressal in the terms of th is Leaseback Agreement against the Lessor (as the Lessee may determine in its sole discretion). 
 
 RENEWAL AND TERMINATION 
 
 Upon lapse of the initial lock-in period of ten (10) years, the Lease Period may be renewed for a further period of ten (10) years upon written mutual consent of the Parties and on the same terms and conditions as this Leaseback Agreement . 
 
 T his Lease back Agreement may be terminated upon written mutual consent of both Parties . 
 
 In the event of termination of this Leaseback Agreement, the Lessee shall hand over peaceful and vacant possession of the Demised Premises to the Lessor. 
 
 FORCE MAJEURE 
 
 “Event of Force Majeure” means an act of God including but not limited to fire, flood, earthquake, windstorm or other natural disaster; act of any sovereign authority including but not limited to war, invasion, act of foreign enemies, hostilities (whether war be declared or not), civil war, rebellion, revolution, insurrection, military or usurped power or confiscation, nationalization, requisition, act of terrorism or destruction or damage to property by or under the order of any government or public or local authority or other Competent Authority or imposition of government sanction embargo or similar action; labour dispute including but not limited to strike, lockout or boycott; interruption or failure of utility service including but not limited to ele
